draft.subject: two order entry roles
draft.body:
Hi Gareth,

Saw Larkfield is hiring two order entry administrators to process emailed and phoned-in orders. Firms like yours lose around 23% of their margin to manual re-keying.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Worth a look?
